name: ungoogled-chromium
description_en: Google Chromium, sans integration with Google
readme_excerpt: ungoogled-chromium A lightweight approach to removing Google web service dependency Help is welcome! See the docs/contributing.md document for more information. Objectives In descending order of significance (i.e. most important objective first): 1. ungoogled-chromium is Google Chromium, sans dependency on Google web services. 2. ungoogled-chromium retains the default Chromium experience as closely as possible.
